title: CyberArmor Registration

[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Steps to Register for CYBERARMOR"][/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_tta_accordion active_section="-1" collapsible_all="true"][vc_tta_section title="STEP - 1: INTRODUCTION" tab_id="1773988313644-a72761a0-0309"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="About Cybersecurity Fundamentals"]

Cybersecurity fundamentals are the basic principles and practices used to protect computer systems, networks and data from cyber threats, unauthorized access, and attacks. It focuses on ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) of information.

The Cybersecurity Fundamentals course has been designed as a structured 12-week learning program delivered through a Learning Management System (LMS) with Virtual Lab. The objective of this course is to introduce students to the essential concepts of cybersecurity and provide practical exposure to security challenges and solutions in modern digital infrastructure.

The course structure combines content-based learning, activity-based learning, self-learning modules, and virtual laboratory exercises to create a comprehensive and engaging educational experience.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Project Background"]

This LMS-based course module has been developed as part of the Cybersecurity in Power Systems project funded by AICTE under the MODROB scheme. The initiative aims to modernize laboratory facilities and integrate advanced cybersecurity training tools and virtual learning environments for engineering students.

The project has been implemented at ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru, with the goal of enhancing student competencies in cybersecurity awareness, practical skills, and research in secure power system infrastructure.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Course Structure"]

These modules introduce fundamental cybersecurity concepts through structured learning materials and guided activities. Each module includes learning materials, interactive activities, Practical exercises using virtual labs, short assessments to reinforce conceptual understanding.

Students are exposed to key topics covered in Modules such as: Module-1: Introduction to Cybersecurity Module-2: Cyber offence Module-3: Tools and Methods used in Cybersecurity Module-4: Cybersecurity Resources Module-5: Detecting and Evaluating IP address Vulnerabilities Module-6: Simulating a Password Attack Module-7: Phishing Attack Simulation Module-8: Encryption and Decryption Module-9: WIFI- Hacking with Evil Twin Attack Module-10: Cybersecurity in Power Systems (Demo) Module-11:  Networks Sniffing and Man in the Middle Attack Module-12: Penetration Testing with nmap Module-13: Simulating Denial of Service(DoS) Attack Module-14: Building a Virtual Private Network[/eikra-vc-text-title][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Target Audience:"]
  • UG students
  • PG students
  • Graduates
  • Working professionals who are interested in learning cybersecurity are eligible to enroll in this course.
[/eikra-vc-text-title][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Continuous Internal Evaluation and Semester End Exam"]
  • Each module will include a Pre-Assessment (non-graded) and a Post-Assessment, which will consist of an Assessment Quiz. The minimum passing grade is 50%.
  • Each student will be given three attempts to successfully complete Post assessment under each Module.
  • A final examination will be conducted at the end of the course. The schedule and details of the examination will be communicated to users through their registered email and official announcements.
[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="STEP - 2: PAYMENT" tab_id="1773988313658-9840138c-df08"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="CyberArmor Payment for Registration"]

Please scan the QR code below using your UPI app and complete the payment to proceed with your registration.
